name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students (Degree)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Government of India
unchecked_criteria: Must have a disability of at least 40% (disability certificate required)
Must be admitted to the first year of a degree course in an AICTE-approved institution, or to the second year through lateral entry
The gap between passing the qualifying exam and admission must not exceed two years
Must not receive any other financial assistance, scholarship or stipend during the course
benefit: Rs 50,000 per year for up to 4 years (3 years for lateral entry). No additional grant for hostel or medical charges.
documents: Disability certificate confirming at least 40% disability
Family income certificate issued by State/UT Government
